_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Applies chosen structure layout split; rewrites shared chrome and page bodies.

description: Rewrite flat pages to layout + fragments (draft). Do not call while requiredDecision pending — user must pick editable first. It extracts header/footer only: afterwards share_section with no arguments lists the other repeated blocks (banner, CTA).

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

ifMatch.description: Manifest etag from structure_site_analyze or get_structure_status.

mode.description: Default apply. Neither value is a dry run — review-only persists the same content/layout write as apply. Only pass review-only after a review_required error (low analyze confidence); it labels the result outcome "review" and defers primary-nav auto-wiring to a later apply call.

restructure.description: Required true when scope all and site has structured pages.

name: structure_site_apply
